data_kind: selected-scene bracket from official daily tide extrema
source_access_note: The official 2023 PDF remains indexed and its table content is retrievable through search/indexed copies, but a fresh GitHub Actions HTTP download currently redirects to a 404. To avoid pretending the dead archive URL is reproducible, only the extrema bracketing the three selected 2023 Sentinel-2 scenes are preserved here with explicit provenance.
phase_definition: 0 at previous extrema and 1 at next extrema; used only as a relative tide-stage descriptor.
scientific_limit: Heights are above Lowest Low Water and are not MSL. Do not compare the numeric LLW heights directly with the 2026 MSL hourly series. The phase fraction is not a harmonic water-level interpolation.
